newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Police nab runaway Russia soldiers who shot driver.
newsitem.headline: Police nab runaway Russia soldiers who shot driver.

text.p: Three fugitive army sergeants were captured on Tuesday after stealing weapons, hijacking a car and shooting dead its owner in the latest in a series of violent crimes by Russian soldiers.

The men were seized after police found an abandoned car with three Kalashnikovs, ammunition, documents and military uniforms in the Ural capital Yekaterinburg, regional police spokesman Anatoly Feoktistov said.
"Police carried out an impeccable operation and seized the men without firing a single shot. The case has now been referred to investigators and the courts," he said.
On Monday the three soldiers hijacked a car whose driver had tens of millions of roubles (thousands of dollars), then took him into the woods and shot him in the head.
They fled their base earlier by wounding a sentry with a knife and comandeering a military vehicle to make their getaway.
Violence among soldiers has become commonplace as economic hardships have caused a slump in morale for Russia's 1.8 million servicemen.
Last week a Russian soldier serving with peacekeeping forces in Georgia's breakaway Abhazia region shot dead 10 fellow servicemen and then killed himself.
Just days before that, another solider killed five people after fleeing his unit in the Far East. He was later captured.
